_comment: QA calibration labels (scripts/calibrate.py, tests/test_qa.py test_calibrated_labels). Direct Tripo outputs only (K17); source: _research/prior-testset.md. `positive`: known defects that a code should catch. `clean`: no known defect, so no shipping code may fire. `agent_eye`: known defects with no automatic code, checked on the render sheet; a case with neither `positive` nor `clean` (pickup_g2) is reported but not scored. `yaw`: the model is first turned by normalize.py (temp copy) so its left/right lies on world X; `args` go to qa.py. Fronts were read off the render sheets: tool_chest_g1 drawers face +X raw (+Y after yaw 90), engine_block_g1 belt end faces +X, the bellows tube axis is X raw (its frames are front and back; after yaw 90 the mirror compares its two pleated sides).
